subject: general
question: Which river creates the Jog Falls, also called Gersoppa Falls?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Sharavati river.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The famous **Jog Falls** is in Karnataka state.
 
• Jog Falls is also known as Gersoppa fall.
 
• Jog Falls was formed by the Sharavati river.
 
• Sharavathi Dam, officially known as the Linganamakki Reservoir, is built across the Sharavathi river.
 
• The catchment area of the Sharavati river is 2,029 sq. km. 
 
• The Sharavati is a major river in Karnataka flowing towards the west.
 
• The Sharavati arises in the Shimoga district of Karnataka.
